card.name: Inside dosage-form names
card.fires_on: The word that completes a dosage-form or route phrase after a drug name, such as extended-release, transdermal system, inhalation aerosol, or injection sites. It fires on the middle piece just before the form word (tablets, system).

modes.label: Extended-release / transdermal
modes.description: The -release or transder-mal piece after a drug name, just before tablets or system.
modes.example: tramadol hydrochloride extended<<-release>> tablets at a dose rounded down to next

modes.label: Other form or route words
modes.description: Words such as injection or aerosol, or a short word like a after a drug name.
modes.example: discontinue beclomethasone dipropionate HFA inhalation<< aeros>>ol slowly.
